text:
Customer ACME: Hey, after we pinned a model in the Console yesterday our vector ingestion started failing. Our vector DB (vectordb-pro) throws "dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024" when ingesting new embeddings.

Customer ACME: We pinned using the Console workspace pin UI to "openembed-large:stable". Our API call is simple: 

```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"openembed-large","input":["user profile text ..."]}
```

Customer ACME: Old responses were length 1536, new ones are 1024. Can you tell us what changed and how to roll back? This breaks our nightly index job.

Support: Eli: Thanks — sorry about the break. We're triaging. Can you confirm whether you created a workspace-level pin vs org-level, and whether you used the Console or the pins API? Also, any sample response you received (we don't need the full vector, just the length) would help.

Customer ACME: Workspace-level pin via Console. Sample response snippet: `{ "model":"openembed-large-q4","embedding":[0.0003, -0.0011, ...] }` length=1024.

Maya (ML): I pulled the model resolver logs for the workspace. The alias `openembed-large:stable` resolved to `openembed-large-q4_2` after the pin — that is a quantized variant with a different embedding head tuned to 1024 dims. Console showed the base name which hid the suffix.

Noah (SE): Repro steps I ran from my sandbox: 

```
# quick check
for m in ["openembed-large","openembed-large-q4_2","openembed-large-1536"]:
  resp = curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"%s","input":["hello world"]}'
  echo "$m -> $(jq '.embedding | length' <<< "$resp")"
```

Noah (SE): Results: openembed-large -> 1024 (because alias resolved), openembed-large-q4_2 -> 1024, openembed-large-1536 -> 1536.

Sachin (Infra): Root cause summary: the pin resolved to a cost-optimized quantized variant. The Console pin flow showed only the human-friendly alias which ended up ambiguous. Also noticed a secondary issue: when some requests in a batch hit different resolved variants (rare race during rollout), downstream post-processing normalized to the shortest vector in the batch which can truncate others — bad.

Support: Eli: Short-term customer options:
- Re-pin to the explicit 1536 variant id (openembed-large-1536) via the API or Console (we can do this for you if you want).
- Re-run the index job with a migration to 1024 (if you can change vectordb shape).
- Temporary: we can enable a per-workspace compatibility guard so the API will reject embeddings whose dim doesn't match the workspace's expected dim (we can flip this quickly for a single workspace).

Customer ACME: Please re-pin to the explicit 1536 id and enable a warning header if embeddings suddenly change dims. We need a signal to pause our ingest.

Sachin (Infra): Done: re-pinned workspace to `openembed-large-1536` at 1772503000. I also added a workspace-level header X-Redwood-Embedding-Dim on embedding responses containing the vector dim for visibility. Rolling to prod in the next 10m.

incident-bot: Incident INC-5176 created: "ambiguous-pin-causes-embed-dim-change". Priority: P1. Teams assigned: eng-ml, eng-infra, devex.

Maya (ML): Mitigation roadmap:
- ENG-1012: Prevent ambiguous aliasing in pin resolver (validate resolved variant and show variant suffix in Console) — hotfix targeted this week.
- ENG-1013: Batch homogenization check — ensure we never mix vectors from different head sizes in the same response; fail batch with clear error instead of truncation.
- DEVEX-210: Add schema warning and explicit dim header in SDKs and Console notification when pins change resolved dims.

Caroline (PM): Communication: we'll send a short customer-facing note about pin behavior and add a console banner for affected workspaces. Also adding a workspace webhook option on pin-change events per customer's request.

Noah (SE): Small repro script for customers to validate their workspace quickly (Python):

```
import requests
key = "<REDACTED>"
url = "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings"
for m in ["openembed-large","openembed-large-q4_2","openembed-large-1536"]:
    r = requests.post(url, json={"model":m,"input":["check dim"]}, headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {key}"})
    dims = len(r.json().get('embedding', []))
    print(m, dims)
```

Sachin (Infra): Also scheduled: a 2-hour sweep to enumerate all workspace pins and resolved model dims, and flag any workspace where the most-recently-used embeddings differ from the pinned variant dims. We'll send warnings and/or opt-in migration help.

Support: Eli: Customer updated — they accepted the explicit re-pin and confirmed ingestion success. They asked for (1) a webhook/event on pin changes and (2) an audit of other ambiguous pins. We've tracked both requests under ENG-1014 (webhook) and SRE-812 (sweep & alerts).

Customer ACME: Re-index finished, ingest is green. Thanks for the quick help. Please let us know when the console shows full variant ids and when webhook support is available.

Support: Eli: Closing thread for now; incident remains open until ENG-1012 and SRE-812 complete. We'll follow up here when the console change and webhook are live.
